profile_text.body:
Snap Inc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, and traded under the ticker SNAP. Its website is snap.com, and its SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001564408. The company also appears under the alias SNAP INC - A.

On its own site, Snap describes itself around the camera, stating that it believes the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. It says it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The facts held on the company list no products and no lawsuits. Its legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
